newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-EUROPEAN CUP QUARTER-FINALS MATCH ANALYSIS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EUROPEAN CUP QUARTER-FINALS MATCH ANALYSIS.

text.p: Analysis of key elements of Wednesday's European Cup quarter-final second-leg matches (first-leg scores in parentheses):
Atletico could be without Juan Eduardo Esnaider who scored their first-leg goal. The Argentina striker is recovering from tonsillitis.
They hope to welcome back Kiko from suspension, although he has a foot injury.

Ajax will be without the suspended Patrick Kluivert and could be missing Finnish striker Jari Litmanen who is nursing a hip injury but Winston Bogarde could return after a fit of pique kept him out of the first leg. - - - - Juventus (Italy) v Rosenborg Trondheim (Norway) (1-1) Juventus coach Marcello Lippi may make two changes from the side which beat Roma 3-0 at the weekend with Mark Iuliano replacing the cup-tied Portugese defender Manuel Dimas and Yugoslav midfielder Vladimir Jugovic taking Alessio Tacchinardi's place. Alessandro Del Piero is still ruled out by injury while Croat striker Alen Boksic, who has played only 10 minutes of competitive soccer in the last two months, starts on the substitutes' bench. Rosenborg, preparing for the match in Antibes in France, report no injury problems and have no players suspended. Defender Erik Hoftun, who had a cold, has recovered and took part in training on Sunday and Monday. - - - - Borussia Dortmund (Germany) v Auxerre (France) (3-1) Borussia have doubts over midfielder Paulo Sousa and striker Karlheinz Riedle, who both missed Saturday's league defeat at Stuttgart. Joerg Heinrich is likely to take the place of the suspended Stefan Reuter at right back. Defender Julio Cesar is still recovering from a knee operation at Christmas and will definitely not play.
Auxerre captain Franck Silvestre, who missed Auxerre's last league match because of injury, should return with ex-Dortmund libero the Australian Ned Zelic on the bench.

Wing-back Steve Marlet misses the match through injury with Antoine Sibierski or Thomas Deniaud playing on the right of the attack in a 4-3-3 formation. - - - - Porto (Portugal) v Manchester United (England) (0-4) Porto will be without suspended Brazilian striker Artur Oliveira, midfielder Rui Barros and international defender Sergio Conceicao and will also be missing injured international striker Domingos Oliveira. Manchester United's only injury doubt concerns striker Andy Cole who pulled a thigh muscle during United's 2-0 win over Sheffield Wednesday on Saturday. Roy Keane and Nicky Butt have both recovered from injuries.
